_comment: Machine-readable ruled strings. SOURCE OF TRUTH for the positive-pin wording gate (gy-uu7mt). Owner: content. Byte-exact: consumers must compare with ==, never retype. Entries with verbatimIn also appear verbatim in that doc. Template entries contain {placeholders}. Any change here is a content ruling and bumps `version`.

terms.retiredNote: Advisory only. The pin (strings above) is the gate; this list is context for reviewers. Editorial advice to any trainer and attributed quotes are exempt.

strings.notes: The price half of the earlier trial.detail varies by surface on purpose (home FAQ, terms and pricing.md word the price differently), so only this eligibility sentence is pinned.
